scope_chirho: Web publication on audiobiblerad.io under the owner's resumed instruction, i think publish it. Native/store, key requests, signup, outreach and paid-plan changes were not part of this release.

routing_chirho.dns_transition_chirho: The original registrar zone had only parking A and www CNAME records. Nine public ACME TXT values were temporarily mirrored to its two challenge names and subsequently removed with readback. Its former parking A answers now match the TLS-verified Cloudflare edges for stale delegation caches; www CNAME was preserved. Cloudflare-managed DNS remains canonical; copied edge addresses are not a permanent origin contract. No unrelated mail, TXT or CAA records were present or removed.

production_verification_chirho.method_chirho: Normal production URL in a fresh Chromium context, actual upstream audio, original Audio element observed without media interception. Each clock advanced and each recording's credit and source/licence links were present. No Scripture media was saved.

preserved_failures_chirho.finding_chirho: The local-only probe identified all HTTPS audio as Scripture, including same-origin tuning WAVs on a hosted page. The probe now excludes same-origin audio; hosted and production reruns passed. No player change was needed.

An old delegation path still served the registrar parking page, including 200 parking responses at private-looking paths. This did not expose project files. The former provider's address answers were aligned with verified Cloudflare addresses; normal HTTPS reruns then passed. The HTTP verifier now stops on a wrong home identity before its asset sweep.

retention_chirho: Private registrar/account preimages, mutation readbacks and one previous verified prepared generation remain on the internal disk for this release's rollback and audit. Regenerable build cache used the external-first isolated adapter. No source audio, credentials, private records or sole release evidence went to external cache storage.
limits_chirho: Browser event timing is not acoustic latency or a physical-device measurement.
This does not verify every upstream chapter, spoken content, real iOS/Watch/Android or background/headset behavior.
Some external DNS caches may take longer to converge. Both old and new nameserver paths now answer usable addresses for this domain.
The existing catalogue's listed-versus-opened availability distinction remains unchanged.
